title: Gangreen 1: Black Venus
author: Jef Geeraerts
current_text: In November 1969, agents of the B.O.B., a police surveillance and investigation brigade, seized one copy of Gangreen 1: Black Venus from Corman bookshop in Brussels.

sources.quote: Krantenartikel 'Gangreen werd in beslag genomen': Artikel in Gazet van Antwerpen over de inbeslagname van enkele boeken door de B.O.B (bewakings- en opsporingsbrigade van de politie) in november 1969. Agenten van de B.O.B. nemen in boekhandel Corman in Brussel één exemplaar van Gangreen mee.
sources.title: Gangreen 1: Black Venus | Letterenhuis

ban_rows.note: A month after winning the Triennial State Prize for Prose, the novel was seized from a Brussels bookshop on the Justice Minister's order as 'morally degenerate'; released roughly a week later.
